description: Team Parallax brings together curious minds passionate about technology, science, and innovation. I'm an AI undergraduate at FAST-NUCES with experience in AI/ML, Python, computer vision, data science, and web development. We're looking for creative problem-solvers, developers, designers, researchers, and space enthusiasts who enjoy collaboration, learning, and turning ambitious ideas into reality. No need to know everything—just bring curiosity, commitment, and a willingness to build!
